Documentation for the minds-owned device id work: added the blueprint plan (`blueprint/minds-device-id/plan-minds-device-id.md`) describing how minds takes ownership of its device id instead of reading the mngr local provider's `host_id` file, and updated `specs/workspace-sync/spec.md` so the record-assembly section describes `device_id` as the minds-owned per-install id at `<data_dir>/device_id` (adopted from the legacy mngr `host_id` on first run) rather than "minds env's mngr `host_id`".
